uxHypotheses.title: Test next-step clarity around pricing and audit calls

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

uxHypotheses.evidence: Homepage repeats Get Pricing, while its closing section invites a free audit call and an ROI discussion.
uxHypotheses.hypothesis: A concise description of what the next step includes could improve qualified visitor understanding.
uxHypotheses.test: Ask target buyers to explain the next step before clicking; then test a clearly scoped label against the current one if volume permits.
uxHypotheses.metric: Qualified completed bookings / eligible landing sessions; booking attendance and qualification as guardrails.
uxHypotheses.dependency: Requires Internal Access: GA4 events, booking provider and CRM qualification.

uxHypotheses.title: Test a concise route from service scope to relevant proof

source.title: Shopify SEO Agency Built for AI Search | SEOasis | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

uxHypotheses.evidence: Service page has approach, process, revenue proof, extensive explanatory sections, pricing and FAQs; multiple headings repeat collection-page and AI themes.
uxHypotheses.hypothesis: A small scope-and-proof summary or jump links could help a time-constrained founder find the service and most relevant case.
uxHypotheses.test: Run task-based reading sessions; measure time to locate deliverables and relevant proof before any page-length change.
uxHypotheses.metric: Task completion and qualified service-to-booking progression; preserve organic intent coverage.
uxHypotheses.dependency: Requires Internal Access: analytics paths and CRM; rendered UX review remains a separate QA gate.

uxHypotheses.title: Test proof navigation by growth problem

source.title: Ecom SEO Case Studies | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

uxHypotheses.evidence: Case-study hub includes different categories and channels, such as collection-page growth, inherited hack cleanup, GEO and organic Shopping.
uxHypotheses.hypothesis: Problem-led filters or a curated path could help prospects select evidence relevant to their own catalog and constraints.
uxHypotheses.test: Ask buyers with a defined scenario to choose the most relevant case; test grouped navigation only after observing friction.
uxHypotheses.metric: Relevant-case discovery, case-to-booking progression and lead fit.
uxHypotheses.dependency: Requires Internal Access: GA4 and CRM; no claim that current visitors struggle.

uxHypotheses.title: Test compact measurement context beside revenue proof

source.title: Bronson Vitamins: Google Merchant Center Case Study | SEOasis | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

uxHypotheses.evidence: Organic Shopping case explicitly gives May 2026 vs. prior period, sessions, purchases, revenue and methodology; public before/after results cannot independently establish causation.
uxHypotheses.hypothesis: A concise comparison-period and attribution note beside summaries could support sophisticated buyers evaluating relevance and evidence.
uxHypotheses.test: Use a research session to check whether readers can identify period, channel, denominator and limits; approve any revised claims with the account owner.
uxHypotheses.metric: Proof comprehension and qualified-call questions; no target uplift invented.
uxHypotheses.dependency: Requires Internal Access: original reports, comparison definition and permission to publish.

uxHypotheses.title: Test a suitable path for technical and nontechnical audit visitors

source.title: Free ChatGPT Visibility Audit — Claude Code Plugin | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

uxHypotheses.evidence: Audit page offers install commands, states prerequisites near the form and in a dedicated section, then offers a strategy call.
uxHypotheses.hypothesis: Keeping prerequisites and the assisted next step prominent could help visitors choose the path suited to their capability.
uxHypotheses.test: Observe technical and nontechnical prospects explaining prerequisites and choosing install vs. call; avoid interpreting email capture as successful audit activation.
uxHypotheses.metric: Qualified audit activation and qualified bookings, measured separately; form completion and setup support load as guardrails.
uxHypotheses.dependency: Requires Internal Access: consented form, activation and CRM data. Do not collect API keys in this dashboard.

prioritizationExample.title: Illustrative decision, no invented inputs

source.title: Ecom SEO Case Studies | SEOasis
source.note: Public server-delivered HTML from research/technical/sample.json. Scripts, responsive behavior, form completion and bookings were not tested in this workstream.

prioritizationExample.evidence: Hypothetical operating decision without numerical assumptions.
prioritizationExample.beforeAccess: Prioritize by relevant public intent evidence, impact hypothesis, confidence and effort. Leave revenue potential unscored.
prioritizationExample.afterAccess: A modest-demand in-stock collection with strong contribution and qualified new-customer purchases may outrank a higher-traffic collection with weak margin, returns or unavailable inventory. Validate cohort evidence before changing priority.
prioritizationExample.guardrail: Revenue potential is Requires Internal Access until catalog, margin, inventory and measurement inputs are validated.

experimentWorkflow: Agree account goal, owner and primary metric; preserve the original definition.
Validate events, deduplication, consent and Shopify reconciliation before baseline.
Record hypothesis, eligible cohort, release date and a meaningful decision rule.
Use qualitative research when conversion volume is too low for a reliable split test; do not declare significance from small samples.
Check accessibility, performance, merchandising, stock and organic intent as release guardrails.
Review weekly; decide scale, revise or stop in the 90-day post-mortem.
guardrails: SEOasis is an agency; its site is not being audited as a Shopify merchant.
All UX effects are untested hypotheses; public HTML does not prove conversion friction or loss.
Published case metrics remain attributed publisher claims; no baseline is adopted as verified client performance.
GSC cannot by itself identify revenue per keyword; connect aggregate page/intent evidence with analytics under documented limits.
Do not sum assisted revenue with attributed revenue or treat before/after revenue as proven incrementality.
GA4 event names are proposed instrumentation; implementation must follow current official documentation and the client consent setup.
